slides.title: Lovable
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Lovable, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Lovable is an AI app builder that turns natural-language descriptions into full, working web applications — frontend, backend, and database.
You chat to refine it, then publish.
It's a paid tool (included in Lenny's bundle) aimed at non-engineers who want to ship real software.
slides.narration: Lovable is an AI app builder that turns natural-language descriptions into full, working web applications — frontend, backend, and database. You chat to refine it, then publish. It's worth a look.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: spin up a simple classroom tool — a reading-log tracker or a field-trip signup form
SMB owners: build a custom booking page, inventory tracker, or customer intake form without hiring a developer
Community leaders: create a volunteer signup or event RSVP app for your organization
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can spin up a simple classroom tool — a reading-log tracker or a field-trip signup form; SMB owners can build a custom booking page, inventory tracker, or customer intake form without hiring a developer; Community leaders can create a volunteer signup or event RSVP app for your organization.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
